description: Schema for a single WPC Excessive Rainfall Outlook (ERO) record. Each row in the output GeoParquet file conforms to this schema.

product.description: Product name (e.g. 'Day 1 Excessive Rainfall Potential Forecast').

issue_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the outlook was issued (UTC).

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the outlook valid start (UTC).

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the outlook valid end (UTC).

geometry.description: WKB-encoded polygon geometry of the outlook area.
